acceptance: A static edge becomes executed only when a captured event or runtime trace identifies it.
A shader equation becomes selected only when its bytecode hash and constants match the captured draw.
A target format becomes active only when the bound view/resource descriptions and writes match.
A matching final screenshot cannot replace intermediate or state evidence.
Proton/DXVK captures require proof of the correspondence to the original D3D11 resources/events before claiming native API equivalence.

limitations: Saved Ghidra analysis is partial; missing functions/references are unknown.
Native bytes prove static operations and possible calls, not runtime selection or universal frame order.
Identified shader classes/targets do not establish pass activity, complete materials, output transfer or visual parity.
No retail game launch, injected hook, Windows execution, GPU frame capture or renderer tuning occurred in this investigation.
Private raw exports and proprietary bytes remain outside the repository.
naming_policy: Native call and address proof does not, by itself, prove the full semantic role of a helper. Function labels without target RTTI/object dataflow are navigation labels assisted by matching source; unknown stage A/B/C identities remain open.
